expo-sdk-fixture-tooling.reason: Transitive Expo SDK fixture and CLI tooling. Keep Expo-managed versions aligned; do not apply broad overrides.

dev-test-tooling.reason: Transitive Jest tooling used only by this repository's tests. Not shipped to consumers.

lint-time-glob-matching.reason: Glob matching inside bundled ESLint plugins. Patterns come from the consumer's own lint configuration, not from untrusted input, and run only at lint time.

lint-time-message-templates.reason: Handlebars inside eslint-plugin-boundaries compiles only the rule message templates authored in the consumer's own lint configuration, with file and element paths as data, at lint time.
